# A muxt:fmt comment muxt fmt does not know is an error: the file is not
# formatted, and the error names where the comment is.

! muxt fmt page.gohtml
cmp stderr want-err.txt
! stdout .

-- page.gohtml --
<div>
{{/* muxt:fmt of */}}
</div>
-- want-err.txt --
page.gohtml:2:1: unknown directive "muxt:fmt of": want muxt:fmt off, muxt:fmt on, or muxt:fmt preserve
